method: Authenticated source, ELF/program-header/region hashes, compiler-unwind function ranges, exact reviewed MIPS32 instructions and bounded tables

ui_events.finding: Color commit stores selection, applies pipeline, then reaches generic menu transition; selection helper modifies RAM flags rather than directly serializing settings.

settings.bank_selector_limit: Selector also uses banks8,9,10 and special fixed pointers; four copied banks do not cover every active mode.

transaction.media_operations_semantics: Prepare/write/read interpretation is an inference from call order, buffer use and checksum readback; exact physical flash operation boundaries remain unproven.

settings.finding: Mode-selected menu transitions stage RAM fields into the shared store before calling a media transaction that writes, reads back and compares a trailer byte. Filename arguments to the view copy helpers are ignored in the reviewed helpers; UiView.bin is not evidence of file-based persistence.

debug_dispatch.flag_bit0: Receive payload before handler through 0x80795fe0; not an authorization bit

getmem.side_effects: Calls cache/memory preparation 0x800b52e4, timestamps and status helper 0x8020108c; not established as a purely passive interface.

coverage.question: UI selection and state layout
coverage.remaining: Physical buttons, all creators and complete event ownership

coverage.question: Persistent-settings route
coverage.remaining: Physical media geometry, checksum coverage, transaction recovery/atomicity, power-cycle observation

coverage.question: GetMem registration and dispatch
coverage.remaining: External activation/mode/endpoints, command-state population from that transport, installed firmware correspondence

coverage.question: Full backup and recovery
coverage.remaining: Complete flash/calibration capture and demonstrated restore; fixed Nanddn loop is insufficient

limitations: Bounded static v1.1 findings; no original C source, runtime execution, device observation or supported API is recovered.
Full function linear decoding and direct calls do not establish entrypoint reachability or whole-program coverage.
Index0xf3 is a proven internal table index; it is not a PTP operation code or a validated host request recipe.
GetMem command state may be populated separately; dispatcher payload alone does not establish its memory-read framing.
User-store stage/load sizes are inferred from reviewed copy loops, independently asserted loop constants and delay slots.
No firmware patch, media access, marker creation, USB request, update or recovery operation is performed.
